walkthroughs.body_html:
Radio - micro - IR - visible - UV - X - gamma.

Wavelength decreases; frequency increases.

Reflection: angle of incidence = angle of reflection.

Refraction: light slows in denser medium; bends towards normal.
v = f lambda. For light: 3 x 10^8 = f lambda.

mcqs.q: If one EM wave has a higher frequency than another, what is true about its wavelength?
options: It is unchanged — only the speed differs.
It is shorter — wavelength and frequency are inversely related (c = f x lambda).
It is also longer, because both increase together.
The book emits a special invisible signal that your brain detects directly.

mcqs.q: How do you see a non-luminous object like a book?
options: They have the same wavelength because both are used for communication.
Light from a source reflects off the book and enters your eyes.
Your eyes send out beams of vision that hit the book and let you see it.
The book emits a special invisible signal that your brain detects directly.

mcqs.q: Which has the longer wavelength: microwaves or radio waves?
options: They have the same wavelength because both are used for communication.
It is unchanged — only the speed differs.
Microwaves, because they are used in 'big' devices like radar.
Radio waves — they sit at the longest-wavelength end of the EM spectrum.
